start.label: Start
start.description: Runs once per tick. The compiler adds the tick loop, warm-up and per-tick acknowledgement around the chain.

sum_n_ticks.label: Sum of Last N Ticks
sum_n_ticks.description: Sum of the N most recent prices, including the current tick.

price_n_ticks_ago.label: Price N Ticks Ago
price_n_ticks_ago.description: Price N ticks before the current one.

constant.label: Constant
constant.description: Literal number. Prices are in dollars, so 150.25 means $150.25.

set_var.label: Set Variable
set_var.description: Store a value into a hardware variable slot (16-bit signed).

divide.label: Divide
divide.statusNote: Numerator is pre-scaled so ratios keep 2 decimals.

log.label: Log
log.description: log of x in the given base
log.statusNote: No opcode and no practical integer expansion on this ISA.

if.label: If / Else
if.description: Branch on a comparison. Compound logic: nest in Then for AND, chain in Else for OR.

for.label: For (Range)
for.description: Runs Body for each i in [start, end) within ONE tick. For sub-calculations, not for walking back through history.
for.compilesTo: counter in a spare VAR, CMP_LT/GT bound, ADD step, JMP back

buy.label: Buy
buy.description: Buy shares at the current price.
buy.compilesTo: GETSTOCKPRICE → MUL → UPDATEBALANCE (cash −= cost) → EMITDECISION(qty, buf, 1)

sell.label: Sell
sell.description: Sell shares at the current price.
sell.compilesTo: GETSTOCKPRICE → MUL → negate → UPDATEBALANCE (cash += proceeds) → EMITDECISION(qty, buf, 0)

sma.label: SMA
sma.description: Simple moving average over the last N ticks.

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.description: Fractional change over N ticks: 0.05 = up 5%.

volatility.label: Volatility
volatility.description: Sample standard deviation of price over the last N ticks, in dollars.
volatility.statusNote: About 4N + 30 instructions per use; cache it in a variable if several blocks need it.

mean_reversion_bands.label: Mean Reversion Bands
mean_reversion_bands.description: SMA ± k × Volatility. Pair with two If blocks: ≤ lower → Buy, ≥ upper → Sell.
mean_reversion_bands.statusNote: Upper and lower each expand Volatility; about 4N + 40 instructions per band used.
